I came for a regular teeth cleaning. At most clinics or hospitals, after the cleaning is complete, the assistant gives you a mirror to check your teeth. This clinic didn't provide a mirror, and they didn't even ask any further questions; they just turned their backs to do something else. I informed the counter staff that they should add a mirror for customers to check their teeth after the procedure. The counter staff replied that customers could request a mirror if they wanted. Checking teeth after treatment is a basic service that any dental clinic should provide.

Compared to other places, the price wasn't significantly cheaper. Therefore, a basic service that aligns with the quality of service is crucial.

Today I went for a consultation for dental implants. The doctor was very lovely. He gave excellent advice and explained things in a way that was easy to understand. Even though I was very afraid of going to the dentist, the staff were lovely and friendly. The clinic is clean and easy to get to. No need to worry about transportation because the clinic is right on the road at the entrance of Sukhumvit Soi 41, next to a supermarket. After the dental treatment, I went shopping. I was very impressed. ❤️☺️

The location is convenient and easy to get to. Initially, I was going for dental implants, but I decided to get braces first, so I have to come every month. Unfortunately, the orthodontist is only available one day a month, which is difficult. However, the orthodontist is kind. I wish they would explain the treatment plan each time I visit, as I don't know much about it. The queuing system is sometimes fast, sometimes slow. Once, when I had a tooth extracted, I waited for two hours! It was so long, and they even let people who came later get treated first. I was quite annoyed. The staff apologized, but I felt like I wasted more time than anything else. (It seemed like there weren't enough doctors that day; nobody told me anything, I had to ask.) But that was a while ago, so I don't mind anymore. I think I'll continue getting treatment here for a long time, even for dental implants, if the service remains good. I'm writing this honest review to provide information for those who are making a decision, and hopefully, it will serve as feedback for the clinic to improve.

First, I must confirm that my previous dental implant treatment with Dr. Arthiphan was excellent; the implants worked normally without any problems. I can attest that he is gentle and provides good advice, which is why I have always trusted him.

However, after two years, the crown came loose, requiring treatment with another doctor. I didn't mind this, as I thought either doctor would do.
What I encountered was:

- A lack of clear explanation of the treatment plan.

- Unanswered questions, leaving the patient confused about what was happening.

- The atmosphere and methods during the procedure lacked professionalism, making me feel unsafe.

*After the treatment:

- Less than 24 hours later, the implant came loose again. I wouldn't question the quality or procedures if I had received better communication.

- I experienced pain and numbness in my face, from below my eyes down to the corners of my mouth, for up to three days. This is very worrying for a patient.

- My messages on LINE were read but not replied to multiple times.
• Phone calls went unanswered.
• When I urged for a quicker response, I was simply told to wait. Without any assistance in assessing symptoms or providing any information,

during a time when the patient was experiencing significant distress and anxiety, the lack of response or such a response is not just a matter of service, but a matter of “responsibility towards the patient” that should be given greater importance.

Even though I later met with the attending physician who provided the same level of care and explanation,

the previous incident clearly impacted my confidence.

Hopefully, this feedback will help the clinic improve its patient care.
